environment.description: Production deployment on AWS ECS Fargate behind an internal Application Load Balancer in a private subnet (no internet gateway route). Ingress is controlled by a Network Load Balancer with a VPC Endpoint Service, consumed only by approved VPC endpoints from partner accounts. The ALB security group (sg-0a4f8e2c1b) ingress rules reference the NLB's elastic network interface IPs which are allocated from a /28 within 10.200.44.0/24. Additionally, an AWS Network Firewall stateful rule group 'restrict-api-source-cidrs' (arn:aws:network-firewall:us-east-1:111222333444:stateful-rulegroup/restrict-api-source-cidrs) with Suricata-compatible rules drops any TCP traffic to the target group ENIs unless the source IP falls within the documented partner CIDR ranges (10.200.44.0/28, 172.16.88.0/25, 192.168.200.0/24). The VPC has no NAT gateway and no internet gateway attached. Route tables for the private subnets contain only local VPC routes and routes to the Transit Gateway for approved peered VPCs. CORS configuration remains permissive in the application code but is irrelevant since browser-originated requests from the public internet cannot reach the service at the network layer.

config.alb: internal, private subnets only, no public IP
config.vpc: no internet gateway, no NAT gateway, private subnets only
config.security_group_ingress: sg-0a4f8e2c1b allows only from NLB ENI IPs in 10.200.44.0/28
config.route_tables: local VPC routes + Transit Gateway to approved peered VPCs only
config.cors: origins '*' (in application code, but unreachable from internet)
